# The RT64 shaders the web page builds before the game starts: one shader description a line, other mode L and H,
# color combiner L and H, flags, in hex. RT64 specializes each one's WGSL when the page is built and compiles them
# all while the page shows "Preparing graphics", so nothing recorded here draws with the ubershader, which integrated
# graphics can't afford (N64Recomp-browser's README, "Give RT64 a list of the game's shaders").
#
# Recorded from the page opened with ?record-shaders, which prints every description RT64 meets that the list
# lacks, at the page's default settings: the intro and title, the file and mission select, the briefing, the pause
# watch's pages, the start of Dam, Facility, Runway, Surface and Bunker (the opening cutscene, then walking, turning,
# aiming and firing), and Bond killed on Dam with its mission report. Not yet: the later levels, their cutscenes,
# multiplayer. A description missing here draws with the ubershader until its shader is built, as before. Flags
# follow settings (filtering, HDR, MSAA, upscaling), so a change to one of those defaults means recording again.
